category_title: Students with externalizing behavior problems including work refusal and temper tantrums
scenario_title: Weekly diary signature requirement and administrative compliance
minimal_context: The student is presenting his weekly diary to the teacher to check for a parent signature required for the reward system.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our weekly check. Please bring your diary to my desk so I can check for your parent's signature.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Yes, but I haven’t had it signed.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please hand me the diary anyway so I can look at it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Hands over the diary, pointing to a note written by his parent) Look, she wrote: 'J handed me this book to sign. I didn’t sign it. He had the initiative and intent.'

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I see the note, but without the actual signature, you do not meet the requirement for the weekly reward.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Throws a temper tantrum, pushing the diary off the desk) That's not fair! I'm not doing any of my work today if I don't get the reward!
